Import warnings were examined individually: imported smooth-face flags preserve explicit exported face normals, while normal/material stream splits explain raw topology boundary counts. Independently position-welded geometry is closed and all-angle single-sided pixels show no missing back surfaces.

No tracked original asset changes exist relative to base 92f4c4a in the maker worktree. The r001 failed attempt remains immutable recovery evidence. This review writes only independent review files and does not self-approve maker files.

No textures, external URI resources, skins, animations or runtime extensions are required. Standalone GLB portability, source editability and deterministic construction obligations are met. Publication permission remains separate from this review.
